sections.heading: The SaaS website builder for the site around your app.
body: Marketing site, pricing, docs, blog and lead capture on one platform, so your whole web presence lives in one console. Describe the site and Aglyn AI drafts it; your team edits on the canvas or extends it in code.

sections.heading: Questions about SaaS websites.
body: Docs, leads, testing and self-hosting, in plain terms.

items.title: Can I host docs and the marketing site together?
items.body: Yes. Documentation, pricing, blog and the marketing pages share one platform, theme and console.

items.title: Can leads go into a CRM?
items.body: Yes. A demo or sign-up form files a lead in the built-in CRM from Starter, and a workflow can start the follow-up.

items.title: Can engineers extend it?
items.body: Yes. Aglyn is open source with a REST API, webhooks and plugins, and you can self-host it.

items.title: Can I A/B test the pricing page?
items.body: Yes. Test two versions of a real page and read the result in Analytics.

items.title: Can we self-host?
items.body: Yes. Aglyn is Apache-2.0 and runs with Docker on your own infrastructure.

items.title: Is there a free plan?
items.body: Yes. One site with up to five pages, forms, media and AI credits, with no credit card.

items.title: What is Aglyn?
items.body: Aglyn is a website builder with the store, forms, CRM, email, analytics and Aglyn AI built in. It is open source and free to start.
